changelog:
obsidians 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli.
- Access to 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS, all via a unified API.
- Includes detailed usage and model listing instructions for all supported AI tasks.
